name: Steel and aluminium tube
summary: Round and square steel or aluminium tube and angle from furniture, frames, racks and fences.
uses: Frames for carts, shelters, racks and solar mounts
Masts for antennas and small wind turbines
Axles and rollers at a pinch
identify: Bed frames, treadmills, gym machines, shelving, scaffolding, trampolines, fence posts, tent poles and electrical conduit (EMT). Aluminium is light and not magnetic; steel is heavier and magnetic.
test: Look for cracks at welds and bends, and dents that kink the tube. Flex long pieces gently: crackling or bubbled paint means rust inside.

decay.note: Lasts; thin steel tube rusts from the inside if water sits in it.
